intendedUse: Normalize a current Latvian LV-NNNN postcode, retrieve a rights-cleared real postcode Polygon or MultiPolygon through the AGID API, fit the map and render a translucent area with a clear outline and complete provenance.
recordGrain: one current Latvijas Pasts postcode assignment and its truthful postcode surface, with VZD address membership, points, administration, roads, buildings, cadastre and land records kept as separate authorities

m2Definition.definition: A current complete rights-cleared Latvijas Pasts postcode assignment denominator, code-class exceptions and real postcode Polygon/MultiPolygon surfaces are pinned by edition or retrieval basis, effective date, terms, byte length and SHA-256, published as an approved immutable artifact, and loaded through the real LV API/app so a normalized LV-NNNN search fits and renders a translucent area with a clear outline, selected code, geometry kind, official/derived/virtual classification, source, reference date and confidence. Latvijas Pasts tables, VZD address points, organization/institution/post-office/PO-box/route endpoints, administrative or locality polygons, roads, parcels, buildings, point buffers, hulls, Voronoi/raster cells and synthetic fixtures never satisfy M2 by themselves. A derived surface is eligible only from an expressly authorized complete current postal assignment denominator with reproducible lineage, limitations and noncanonical status preserved.

officialObservations.finding: The current official page lists eleven city/municipality PDF postcode books and an address finder. The books assign postcodes to streets, house numbers, localities and other recipients but publish no Polygon/MultiPolygon product. Three PDFs repeatedly returned HTTP 522 through the local non-browser path, so this review does not claim a complete operator denominator. No explicit AGID processing, public-serving or redistribution grant was found.

Eight provider PDFs total 142 pages and are byte-pinned. Their metadata and extracted page text establish current assignment-reference content but no geometry, licence receipt or complete nationwide denominator.

The official package API describes daily current/historical CSV resources and the spatial ZIP. The exact locally observed package body is pinned; distribution dates and sizes below come from this response.

The current CSV has 610,513 unique address-object rows. There are 550,515 active EKS rows; all are approved, have valid LV-NNNN postcodes and WGS84 coordinates, covering 693 distinct active codes. Geometry is Point address context, not a postcode-area release.

ZIP entries and DBF fields were enumerated from the actual current archive. Ekas is address Point geometry with ATRIB as postcode; city/municipality/parish/village polygons and road lines are context. No postal-index Polygon/MultiPolygon layer exists.

VZD states that open data is CC BY 4.0 and permits copying, modification, distribution and commercial/non-commercial use with attribution, licence link and change disclosure. The description and specification list address points, road lines and administrative/locality polygons, not postcode polygons. The specification document itself carries separate document-copy restrictions, so only its digest and observations are committed.
The official catalog API returned zero datasets for the three postcode-boundary searches. This is negative search evidence, not proof that no unpublished or contracted data exists.

dataQuality.risk: Current operator reference books and current rights-cleared VZD address points exist, but the operator denominator is not fully pinned, VZD is address-registry rather than postal-boundary authority, all postcode-bearing VZD geometry is Point, no official postcode-area release was found, and Latvijas Pasts processing/public-serving/redistribution rights remain unresolved.

browserReview.reason: No rights-cleared real LV postcode Polygon/MultiPolygon artifact exists to exercise. Shared deterministic tests do not promote point data or synthetic geometry.

blockerSummary: Latvijas Pasts publishes current assignment-reference PDFs but no postcode Polygon/MultiPolygon release, the complete operator denominator was not byte-pinned, and no explicit AGID processing, public-serving or redistribution grant was found. VZD publishes current CC BY 4.0 postcode-bearing address points and administrative/locality polygons, but points and context polygons cannot be fabricated into postal areas. No rights-cleared real LV postcode surface or immutable artifact can be served or rendered.
unblockConditions: Obtain an unrestricted current authoritative postcode-boundary release, or explicit written Latvijas Pasts permission for AGID processing, public serving and redistribution together with a complete current assignment denominator and approved authoritative geometry/derivation basis.
Pin edition/effective date, code classes, exceptions, terms, byte length and SHA-256; reconcile Latvijas Pasts and VZD membership without promoting civic-address rows into postal authority.

Validate every eligible Polygon/MultiPolygon for closure, coordinate range, topology, LV partition, completeness and endpoint exceptions; do not fill gaps with points, buffers, hulls, Voronoi/raster cells, administration, localities, roads, parcels or buildings.

Publish an approved immutable artifact with no raw addresses, persons, customers, buildings, cadastre or land-right data and pass real LV normalization, loader, API, fit, translucent fill, outline, provenance, clear and re-search verification.
